name: Barbell Overhead Press
steps: Stand with the bar at the upper chest, hands just outside shoulder width.
Brace the abdomen and move the head back slightly to clear the bar.
Press overhead, then bring the head naturally between the arms.
Lower the bar under control to the upper chest.
cues: Keep the bar close to the face as it passes.
mistakes: Using knee drive in a strict press.
breathing: Inhale and brace before the press; exhale as you finish overhead.
